title: deschampsia cespitosa subsp. turczaninowii
intro: Deschampsia cespitosa subsp. turczaninowii, commonly known as Tufted Hair Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Tufted Hair Grass are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote the expulsion of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Tufted Hair Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
